player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take the cauldron while already holding two items, ignoring the inventory limit, and I never successfully added the required ingredients (ectoplasm, lily of the valley, nightshade) to the cauldron before attempting to use the wands. Next time, I will first drop all non-essential items to free up inventory slots, then immediately take the cauldron, followed by taking and adding each ingredient one by one. Only after the cauldron contains all ingredients will I proceed to take the necessary wands (zulpowand and ice wand) and perform the final steps. I will also ensure I do not attempt to take the cauldron until my inventory is empty.
